name: Anyone can read guide pages of live subjects
qual:
(subject_id IN ( SELECT subjects.id
   FROM subjects
  WHERE (subjects.status = 'live'::content_status)))

name: Platform admin full access on guide_pages
School users can read their guide pages
qual:
(subject_id IN ( SELECT subjects.id
   FROM subjects
  WHERE (subjects.school_id = current_user_school_id())))

name: Teachers can update guide pages for their subjects
qual:
((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['teacher'::user_role, 'school_admin'::user_role])) AND (subject_id IN ( SELECT s.id
   FROM subjects s
  WHERE ((s.school_id = current_user_school_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = 'school_admin'::user_role) OR (s.id IN ( SELECT teacher_subjects.subject_id
           FROM teacher_subjects
          WHERE ((teacher_subjects.teacher_id = auth.uid()) AND (teacher_subjects.can_edit = true)))))))))
with_check:
((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['teacher'::user_role, 'school_admin'::user_role])) AND (subject_id IN ( SELECT s.id
   FROM subjects s
  WHERE ((s.school_id = current_user_school_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = 'school_admin'::user_role) OR (s.id IN ( SELECT teacher_subjects.subject_id
           FROM teacher_subjects
          WHERE ((teacher_subjects.teacher_id = auth.uid()) AND (teacher_subjects.can_edit = true)))))))))

name: Platform admin full access on lessons
Students can read live lessons from their school
qual:
((status = 'live'::content_status) AND (unit_id IN ( SELECT u.id
   FROM (units u
     JOIN subjects s ON ((u.subject_id = s.id)))
  WHERE (s.school_id = current_user_school_id()))))
